description: SBK Baskarta - Hamnanläggningar is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Stockholms stad. Port facilities consist of the following object and subtypes (for the current list see General Product Specification Base Map): Port facility: 10, Kaj; 20, berth number (incomplete, not adjourned); 30, Quay Section (incomplete, not adjourned); 40, Fender (incomplete, not adjourned); 50, Bridge; 60, Snow-tipping protection (incomplete, not adjourned); 70, Steel flaps (incomplete, not adjourned); 80 ... Coverage: Stockholms stad. The portal shows the English title as "SBK Baskarta - Port facilities" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Stockholms stad. Its keywords include Fullständiga metadata, Extern dataportal. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2022-10-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
